answer: Fake identities cost real capital, so a gale of new accounts gains nothing without matching deposits. Sybil resistance here relies on a stake-weighted quorum: each agent must lock a quartz-bonded deposit to join the atlas of registered peers, and votes scale with stake, not headcount. Misbehavior slashes the bond, making mass forgery economically self-defeating. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
